title: Tasks app: the 2.0 redesign
goal: Decide what changes in the redesign of a small shared task app before any code is written

brief.text: Phones first; the desktop layout follows
The yearly price may scare off small teams
Who owns a task that two people edited offline?

cards.title: Ship the new pricing page?
cards.tldr: Drag the divider: the left half is today's page, the right half is the redesign.
cards.reason: the highlighted plan doubled trial starts in the last test

cards.title: Which home screen?
cards.reason: most sessions are a 20-second check of what is due

cards.title: Teach the swipe gesture with a short clip?
cards.tldr: A 3-second loop on the first launch, muted.

video.caption: The clip as it would play

left.label: No clip
left.detail: A one-line hint under the first task

right.label: Show the clip
right.detail: Plays once, then a **Got it** button

cards.title: How dense should the task list be?

left.label: Compact
left.detail: One line per task, 9 tasks on a phone

right.label: Roomy
right.detail: Two lines, the note under the title

cards.title: Ship the new date parser?
cards.tldr: It reads «next fri 6pm» and «in 2 weeks»; the old one needed a date picker.

left.label: Not yet
left.detail: Keep the picker until the parser has tests in 5 languages

right.label: Ship it
right.detail: English first, the picker stays as a fallback

cards.title: Price Pro at $8 or $12 a month?
cards.body:
### What we know
| Plan | Price | Trial → paid |
|---|--:|--:|
| Pro today | $6 | 9.1% |
| Test A | $8 | 8.4% |
| Test B | $12 | 5.2% |

> At $12 we earn more per user but lose a third of the conversions.
cards.reason: it grows faster and keeps small teams

cards.title: Send the digest daily or weekly?
cards.reason: daily opens halve within two months

cards.title: Keep the sync flow as drawn?
cards.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Phone edits offline] --> B{Online?}
  B -- yes --> C[Push change]
  B -- no --> D[Queue locally]
  D --> B
  C --> E[Server merges by field]

right.label: Rethink it
right.detail: Last write wins instead of a merge

cards.title: Share a board as a looping preview?
cards.reason: most chat apps don't autoplay a link preview

cards.title: Undo a finished task with a shake?
